text: The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the music mirrors the pulse of the metropolis, while the raw, unfiltered narratives within the lyrics reflect the complex social tapestry of the streets. This auditory layer deepens the viewer's immersion, transforming the gallery space into a dynamic soundscape that resonates with the heartbeat of the city.
